changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwwaseelsbscatalog AS SELECT wsc.id, wsc.waseel_item_type, wsc.sbs_code, wsc.update_type, wsc.revision_details, wsc.short_description, wsc.long_description, wsc.is_active, wsc.source_file_name, wsc.created_date, wsc.created_by, wsc.last_modified_by, wsc.last_modified_date FROM public.waseel_sbs_catalog wsc;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwwaseelsbscatalog TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwwaseelsbscatalog FROM report_user;
